name: The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory

bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be clear and smaller than 12” x 6” x 12”. Small clutch bags, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6” x 9” are allowed and do not need to be clear.
allowed: CLEAR plastic/vinyl tote bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
Small clutch bags, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6” x 9”
prohibited: Large Bags / Backpacks / Luggage / Computer Bags / Camera Bags
Chairs of ANY kind including Lawn Chairs
Outside food or drinks – except factory sealed water
Any other item that may pose a threat
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Save time and money by pre-purchasing event parking. Detailed parking options and pricing are not specified on the website.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory offers a variety of food options including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas, and Koko's Bavarian sausages and pretzels. General concessions include popcorn, nachos, and a selection of drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
